description: This file implements a cache interface for Google Cloud Storage (GCS). It provides methods for setting, getting, and flushing cache entries asynchronously and synchronously, specifically tailored to interact with GCS via HTTP requests. It extends the BaseCache class and integrates with GCS-specific operations.

classes.name: GCSCache
classes.description: A cache implementation for Google Cloud Storage, supporting both sync and async methods for storing and retrieving cache data.

methods.name: None __init__(self, bucket_name: Optional[str] = None, path_service_account: Optional[str] = None, gcs_path: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Initializes the GCSCache with optional bucket name, service account path, and GCS path. Sets up HTTP clients for sync and async operations.

methods.name: dict _construct_headers(self)
methods.description: Constructs the necessary headers for GCS requests, including authentication.

methods.name: set_cache(self, key, value, **kwargs)
methods.description: Stores a cache entry synchronously in GCS.

methods.name: async_set_cache(self, key, value, **kwargs)
methods.description: Stores a cache entry asynchronously in GCS.

methods.name: get_cache(self, key, **kwargs)
methods.description: Retrieves a cache entry synchronously from GCS.

methods.name: async_get_cache(self, key, **kwargs)
methods.description: Retrieves a cache entry asynchronously from GCS.

methods.name: flush_cache(self)
methods.description: Method stub for flushing the cache; currently does nothing.

methods.name: disconnect(self)
methods.description: Method stub for disconnecting, currently does nothing.

methods.name: async_set_cache_pipeline(self, cache_list, **kwargs)
methods.description: Performs multiple asynchronous cache set operations in parallel.
